title: An asymptotically tight bound on oriented diameter
summary: Let $f(d)$ be the smallest integer such that every connected bridgeless graph of diameter $d$ admits an orientation with directed diameter at most $f(d)$. Chvátal and Thomassen (1978) proved $\left\lceil{d^2}/{2}\right\rceil+d\le f(d) \le 2d^2+2d$. In this paper, we prove that $f(d)\le \left\lceil d^2/2\right\rceil+6d$, which shows $f(d)= d^2/2+Θ(d)$ and determine the leading quadratic coefficient of $f(d)$.
